items.title: What happens to an economy when AI makes most human labor optional
items.raw_excerpt: I keep seeing two extreme futures discussed around AI. One is techno utopia: AI does everything, productivity explodes, humans are free to create and chill. The other is collapse: AI replaces jobs, wealth concentrates, consumption dies, society implodes. What I don’t see discussed enough is the mechanism between those states. If AI systems genuinely outperform humans at most economically valuable tasks, wages are no longer the primary distribution mechanism. But capitalism today assumes wages are how demand exists. No wages means no buyers. No buyers means even the owners of AI have no customers. That feels less like a social problem and more like a systems contradiction. Historically, automation shifted labor rather than deleting it. But AI is different in that it targets cognition itself

items.title: 对话何小鹏：今年自动驾驶能力提升10倍，推出四款全新SUV全球车

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, XPeng's performance has been exceptional. Amid widespread industry pressure and intense competition over pricing and configurations, the company delivered over 400,000 vehicles for the year. At a recent global new product launch, XPeng unveiled four new models priced between 180,000 and 300,000 yuan, aiming for even higher sales. This growth stems from adjustments to its product lineup. XPeng is shifting from "single-model breakthroughs" to "multi-model synergy," integrating both pure electric and extended-range vehicles into a unified platform. According to XPeng, with pure electric range now consistently between 600 and 800 kilometers, the marginal value of adding more batteries is diminishing. What truly differentiates the user experience is energy consumption control, efficiency, and the underlying intelligent systems. In recent discussions with domestic and international media, XPeng's Chairman and CEO, He Xiaopeng, appeared confident and optimistic, describing 2025 as a year of "steady progress and breakthrough." In his narrative, XPeng's focus is shifting from "survival" to "going further." XPeng's approach to globalization has also evolved. When discussing vehicle exports, He Xiaopeng now emphasizes local R&D and manufacturing, as well as simultaneous development of left- and right-hand drive models, rather than the previously highlighted channel expansion, certification compliance, and price competition. "We are entering a phase of genuine global development," He Xiaopeng revealed. In 2026, XPeng will not only begin mass production of its first co-developed model with Volkswagen in China in the second quarter but also expand into the American market and establish overseas factories. The year 2026 marks a turning point in XPeng's history, moving beyond its previous strategy of "steady and sustainable growth."
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, el desempeño de Xpeng fue excepcional. En una etapa en la que la industria en general enfrentaba presiones y los precios y configuraciones llegaban a su límite, la empresa logró entregar más de 400.000 vehículos en todo el año. En su reciente lanzamiento global de nuevos productos, Xpeng presentó cuatro modelos nuevos, con precios que oscilan entre 180.000 y 300.000 yuanes, con la intención de alcanzar mayores ventas. Este crecimiento en ventas proviene de un ajuste en la estructura de productos. Xpeng ha comenzado a pasar de un "enfoque en un solo punto" a una "colaboración entre múltiples modelos", integrando vehículos eléctricos puros y de autonomía extendida en una misma plataforma. Según Xpeng, cuando la autonomía de los eléctricos puros se ha estabilizado en el rango de 600 a 800 kilómetros, el valor marginal de añadir más baterías está disminuyendo. Lo que realmente marca la diferencia en la experiencia es el control del consumo energético.
